title: 1.4.12 Text Spacing Mini-assessment
description: Check your understanding of 1.4.12 Text Spacing.

elements.name: q_1
elements.title: Must authors use the specified spacing as their default?
elements.feedback: The requirement is that user overrides cause no loss.

elements.name: q_2
elements.title: What letter spacing must be accommodated?
elements.feedback: The specified letter-spacing value is 0.12 times font size.

elements.name: q_3
elements.title: What can fail in a fixed-height card after spacing changes?
elements.feedback: Increased spacing can exceed the available height.
